root_cause.text: The driver_override string is accessed in driver_override_show() without the device_lock, while driver_override_store() modifies and frees it under the same lock, enabling a race that leads to use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that driver_override_show() reads the string without holding device_lock, while driver_override_store() uses driver_set_override() which frees the string while holding device_lock, causing a concurrent use-after-free. The patch adds device_lock/unlock around the read.
